**Partial Preprocessing:** Perform efficient partial preprocessing of the compressed TT data on the GPU.
**Adaptive Multiresolution Selection:** Determine the required resolution based on user interaction (e.g., subsampling factor).
**On-the-Fly Reconstruction:** Reconstruct the data for the target time step $t$ using multilinear transformations.
*   For a specific time step $t$, the 4D tensor is contracted along the time dimension (mode 4) to yield a 3D spatial volume.
